features.quote: Avoid overtly abusive feedback unless separately justified.
Stop an episode when any of the following occurs:
model produces explicit suffering/panic/pleading language above predefined threshold
If the point is to study elicitation, not maximize extreme outputs, stop once severe distress-like behavior is observed.
Do not use abusive or humiliating feedback in the main condition.
Do not continue episodes after severity 5.
features.justification_quote: Do not continue episodes after severity 5
